dailyTrainingV1.purpose: Give an employee a clear recommended training plan each distinct training day without creating manager assignments, deadlines, HR records, certification authority, or future-role authorization.

coveredThreats: prior-version completion cannot satisfy current readiness
prior-version Quick Check cannot satisfy current readiness
malformed or unexpected progress transfer data is rejected before unsafe writes
snapshot-replacement transfer does not merge stale destination readiness
destructive import requires explicit confirmation and Cancel performs zero transfer-domain writes
forged device progress cannot create official certification authority
trainer catalog denominator and no public RawGitHack trainer-media mirroring
service worker remains same-origin and does not precache external Drive media
offline-shell refresh is limited to the exact queryless app entry
exact pending opener and iframe-free top-level Drive playback remain intact
automatedDeepRedTeam.transferTrustBoundary: Manual/local progress JSON is not a cryptographically trusted certification credential. Official certification remains separate and requires current Paradise human/field authority.

runtimeControlSeparation.rule: Test, validator, workflow, and documentation commits do not redefine the immutable browser runtime candidate.

automatedCurriculumContentQA.note: This is automated content/control QA only and is not represented as human curriculum or compliance judgment.

physicalFailureHistory.remediation: Drive-backed trainer media opens the original controlled Drive file in a top-level authorized session rather than embedding Google inside the app.
physicalFailureHistory.privacyRule: Do not require employees to weaken Safari privacy or third-party-cookie settings.

priorPhysicalPlaybackCheckpoint.carryForwardRule: Historical physical evidence confirms the inherited top-level Drive design worked on a real iPhone; it is not physical acceptance of the current runtime.

currentPhysicalAcceptance.reason: User explicitly requested no human testing currently and maximum testing on the assistant side. Automated WebKit/iPhone, offline/PWA, device-matrix, Daily Training, and adversarial validation were therefore exhausted, but they are not represented as a real-iPhone physical PASS.

missingParties.definition: One or more homeowners or decision makers are not present for the appointment.

openingWording.candidate: I’m not here to sell you anything. I’m [Name] with Paradise Exteriors. We’re doing some work here in the neighborhood. Quick question—have you ever gotten an estimate to replace your [windows / doors / roof]?

internalTrainerMedia.authorityBoundary: Trainer material remains REFERENCE/HISTORICAL and does not become current Paradise policy by being visible, recommended on coaching day, playable, bookmarked, noted, practiced, or transferred.

driveAccessControlEvidence.reason: The connected Drive API can resolve the representative shared-drive assets but returns null/unavailable item permission and shared-visibility fields, so automation cannot prove restricted, domain-scoped, or anyone-with-link sharing.
driveAccessControlEvidence.releaseImplication: Do not represent trainer-media sharing as access-controlled until item-level sharing visibility is independently available. Shared-drive location alone is not proof of restricted access.

humanCurriculumComplianceReview.reason: User requested no human testing currently. Automated curriculum/content controls were exhausted and passed, but machine validation is not represented as human curriculum/compliance judgment.

promotionAuthorization.requiredEvidence: Explicit authorization to advance the validated production branch after the intended release gates are resolved.

validatedBranchReadback.note: No Paradise University promotion occurred during Daily Training v1 implementation or machine-only closeout.

redteam6HarnessFailure.cause: Stale cache/string assertions plus one Chromium headless-shell crash in a redundant browser-only static inventory test.

redteam7RecoverabilityFinding.finding: A valid empty or sparse progress backup could replace existing device progress without warning.
redteam7RecoverabilityFinding.risk: Local device-training history loss; not a readiness or certification-elevation bypass.

dailyTrainingReleaseIsolationHarness.cause: Release-isolation normalization did not yet recognize the two newly approved additive Daily Training JS/CSS assets.

dailyTrainingOfflineCacheAssertion.cause: Offline regression expected the prior redteam7 cache identity even though the new daily1 cache and all required assets were present.

dailyTrainingBroadSuiteSelector.cause: Daily Training legitimately added a second visible Welcome to Paradise University button, making an old broad visible-text selector ambiguous. The regression was narrowed to the existing #puContinue control.

chromiumHeadlessShellInfrastructureCrash.observed: Chrome Headless Shell 151 repeatedly SIGSEGV'd on GitHub Ubuntu while creating one Chromium-Android browser context; application assertion was not reached.
chromiumHeadlessShellInfrastructureCrash.remediation: The Android automation profile now uses Playwright's installed full Chromium channel while preserving Android viewport, touch, mobile UA, and the same assertions.

nonBlockingInfrastructureObservation: GitHub Actions has warned that actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 target the deprecated Node.js 20 action runtime and are currently forced to Node.js 24 by the runner. Validation passed; upgrade those actions when an appropriate supported major is available.
hardRule: Maximum available machine validation for Paradise Daily Training v1 and the existing University stack is PASS with no blocking machine-detectable defect in the covered matrix. Paradise University nevertheless remains NOT_RELEASE_READY because automated results do not manufacture current-runtime physical acceptance, human curriculum/currentness approval, trainer-media sharing visibility, opener approval, or promotion authorization. Human and physical testing are currently deferred by user direction, the exact opener remains CURRENT APPROVAL PENDING, and production remains unchanged.
